intro: Between April 12 and May 1, 2026, ZCyberNews covered ten espionage-focused articles, with APT28 (Fancy Bear) appearing as the most frequently reported threat actor. Other notable actors included Deep#Door and Mustang Panda. The reporting documented eight high-severity and two critical-severity incidents affecting the government, defense, healthcare, technology, and banking sectors. Targeted regions spanned Europe, Southeast Asia, East Asia, India, and global interests.
